features.body: A draconian acting this turn flaps their wings and creates a mighty gale. Each creature [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to the draconian is pushed up to 4 squares, and if they have M < 2, they are knocked [prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone).
features.name: Guarding Gale

sections.label: Special
sections.text: The damage dealt by this ability matches a damage type the draconian has immunity to.

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: The draconian's scales shatter from battle damage. The draconian has damage weakness 5 but can take two turns per round until the end of the encounter.

flavor: At the start of any draconian's turn, you can spend Malice to activate one of the following features.
name: Draconian Malice
